c-anon-invite-landing.1.needs: lane A: enable Settings > General > Anyone can register (users_can_register is 0). Observed with registration closed: page names 'Lisbon Chapter', shows only 'Log in to accept invite', nobody added (member rows 3 -> 3).

c-anon-invite-landing.2.evidence: Login link carries redirect_to=<invite url>; logged in as bob (via autologin on the invite URL, no password available) -> same invite page, button 'Join Space', bob has 0 rows in Lisbon Chapter

c-anon-invite-landing.3.evidence: bob clicked Join Space (POST + nonce) -> landed on /community/s/lisbon-chapter/; space member_count 3 -> 4, invite use_count 0 -> 1

c-anon-invite-landing.4.expected: page shows he already belongs and a link to the space
c-anon-invite-landing.4.actual: no duplicate row (1 row for bob), but the page gives no message: invite.php emits an instant meta refresh into the space, so the member never sees 'already a member'

c-anon-invite-landing.5.evidence: as bob, 2 GETs, a HEAD and a Purpose: prefetch GET all 200 and wp_jt_space_members for space 32 unchanged (3 rows, bob 0)

c-anon-invite-landing.6.evidence: POST /jetonomy/v1/invite/<token> with cookie and no nonce -> 401 rest_not_logged_in; POST to the landing page with a bad jt_invite_nonce re-shows the Join button; bob not added

c-anon-invite-landing.7.needs: lane A: turn registration off/on (@admin check). Note registration is already off site-wide and the page then shows only 'Log in to accept invite'.

c-anon-invite-landing.8.evidence: /invite/does-not-exist/ -> theme 404 'Page not found' (hyphen does not match the token route); a well-formed bogus token /invite/doesnotexist123/ -> 'Invalid invite link.' No fatal. Wording differs from the check, see proposed checks

c-anon-invite-landing.9.evidence: invite with expires_at 2026-10-01 -> 'This invite link has expired or reached its usage limit.', no Join button

c-anon-invite-landing.10.evidence: one-use invite accepted by maya, then bob opens it -> 'This invite link has expired or reached its usage limit.', no Join button

c-anon-invite-landing.11.evidence: bob on invite to 2025 Hackathon -> 'This space is archived or locked and is not taking new members.', no Join button

c-anon-invite-landing.12.expected: omar (space-banned from Off-Topic Lounge) is refused with a ban message
c-anon-invite-landing.12.actual: instant meta refresh into /community/s/off-topic-lounge/ with no message. InviteLink::accept() runs is_member() before join_blocked(), so omar's existing member row skips the ban check. Whether a banned NON-member is refused was not exercised (no restriction changes in lane B).

c-anon-invite-landing.13.evidence: alice and maya clicked Join together on a one-use invite in separate sessions -> alice joined and landed in the space, maya got the usage-limit error; use_count 1, 1 new member row

c-anon-invite-landing.14.expected: buttons are full width and readable
c-anon-invite-landing.14.actual: readable in dark (text #e5e5e5 on #23262f, button light blue with dark text) but the 'Log in to accept invite' button is 181px wide inside a 328px container, centred, not full width

c-anon-invite-landing.15.evidence: logged-out invite to Moderators' Room -> only 'You've been invited to join Moderators' Room', its one-line description and the login button; no members, topics or counts

proposed_checks: - `c-anon-invite-landing.16` @guest #ui !refuse: open /invite/<well-formed but unknown token>/ -> an 'Invalid invite link.' page with HTTP 404 (today it is HTTP 200, a soft 404).

- `c-anon-invite-landing.17` @space_banned #ui !refuse +banned: omar, who still has a member row in Off-Topic Lounge, opens its invite -> the page says he is banned instead of silently redirecting into the space.

- `c-anon-invite-landing.18` @member #ui: as an existing member open an invite to a space he is in -> decide the contract: either a visible 'You are already a member' page with a link (what check 4 says) or the silent redirect (what the code does); fix whichever is wrong.
notes: Lane B created, via admin REST as varundubey, 7 invite links (spaces Lisbon, Berlin, Mexico City, Ai Assistant, 2025 Hackathon, Off-Topic Lounge, Moderators' Room); one expiry was backdated with a one-row update to make an expired invite. All invite rows deleted at the end; bob/maya/alice membership rows removed with SpaceMember::remove (member counts back to 3/3/1). No settings changed. users_can_register is 0 on the site, so the 'Create free account' path is untested. Debug log unchanged (112327 bytes). Screenshots: invite-*.png.
